product.amstrad-pc1286.summary: The lower-cost alternative to the PC2286, with a choice of monitor.
product.amstrad-pc1286.history: Amstrad announced the PC1286 in September 1989 as a lower-cost version of the PC2286 for the business market. In the United Kingdom the base unit started at £750, with a monitor sold separately.
product.amstrad-pc1286.technical.storage: The base unit was announced with one floppy drive. The report gives 2.5 inches, a size that still needs checking against the full brochure or a physical unit.
product.amstrad-pc1286.technical.setup: The separate SETUP utility let users restore settings after the battery ran flat. Amstrad support lists this model.
product.amstrad-pc1286.technical.verifie: The model identity and commercial offer are documented. The BluMach entry is in research.
product.amstrad-pc1286.technical.limitat: A BIOS dump attributable to this model is needed to validate boot and video in BluMach.
